item.title: Congressional Democrats raise alarm over Trump's comments on Iran
item.summary: Dozens of congressional Democrats raised alarm Tuesday over President Trump's rhetoric about Iran. Most Republican lawmakers have been silent.

item.title: ICE acknowledges it is using powerful spyware
item.summary: In a letter sent last week, ICE's top official indicated to members of Congress the agency is using a spyware tool to intercept encrypted messages of fentanyl traffickers.

item.title: Australia charges ex‑soldier with 5 war‑crime murders in Afghanistan
item.summary: Roberts-Smith is only the second Australian veteran of the Afghanistan campaign to be charged with a war crime.

item.title: Telehealth abortion will remain available for now, after a federal judge's ruling
item.summary: The abortion pill mifepristone must undergo a safety review by the FDA, the judge said. Louisiana's case seeking to ban its use through telemedicine will proceed after that review.

item.title: U.K. issues Ye travel ban over antisemitism, leading to festival cancellation
item.summary: The rapper previously known as Kanye West, scheduled to perform this summer in London, was denied entry into the U.K. on the grounds that his presence "would not be conducive to the public good."

item.title: Photos: NASA releases first images from moon flyby
item.summary: During the mission's loop around the moon, the crew took geological observations of places of interest on the lunar surface using their own eyes and snapping thousands of photos of the surface.

item.title: Now cancer-free, 'Roastmaster' comic Jeff Ross still finds humor in loss
item.summary: Known for his ruthless celebrity roasts, Ross turns inward in his Netflix special, Take a Banana for the Ride, which details the loss of his parents and grandfather.

item.title: The Artemis II crew saw parts of the moon never seen before. Here's what they said
item.summary: The astronauts on Artemis II observed parts of the moon humans had never seen before. Their findings provide a scientific baseline — and sense of wonder — for future missions.

item.title: Astronauts suggest naming a moon crater 'Carroll' after their commander's late wife
item.summary: The Artemis II crew, led by Reid Wiseman, was the first to lay eyes on several craters on the far side of the moon. The astronauts want to name one of them after Carroll Wiseman, who died of cancer in 2020.

item.title: Drive slower, go electric, don't drive at all? Americans weigh options for saving gas
item.summary: With gasoline prices averaging above $4 a gallon nationally, drivers are grappling with a sharp rise in fuel costs. Here are some ideas to consider if you're trying to cut your fuel costs.
